question: wiki/open-questions.md item 3: at the sampler defaults (delta 1, eight levels) Neal's funnel is unbiased but one chain per seed collapses to h ~ 0.01 and omega R-hat is 1.01-1.04. levels 8 + delta 0.5 is the known efficient funnel setting (WP28) but was never measured on the 17-model posteriordb screen. Is delta 0.5 free (or better) on ordinary posteriors, so it can become the default? delta 0.75 is the middle arm.

d1.rule: Adaptation::default() + Tuning::default() (literally the shipped default; delta 1, eight levels)

common: Tuning::default() (h0 0.5, depth 10, min_micro_steps 1, eight refinement levels, MomentumSum, divergence threshold 1000) with Tuning::max_error(delta) for the non-default arms; Adaptation::default(); Metric::diagonal() with the Stan regularisation; DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION; Init::uniform(); Limits::admit_worst_case(); four threads; no leaf-error trace
harness: src/main.rs, src/bin/funnel.rs, src/bin/eight_schools.rs and run_delta_half.py, copied from STUDIES/refinement_role_v1 with the arm set reduced to delta, the trace switched off, and the funnel efficiency statistic added
run_order: (1) funnel: arms in arms_order, seeds ascending; (2) Eight Schools strict track: arms in arms_order, seeds ascending; (3) posteriordb: models in listed order, arms in arms_order, seeds ascending. Strictly sequential, one sampling process at a time.
cmdstan_reference: posteriordb_bench_v5 artifacts (CmdStan 2.39.0, seeds 87101-87103), cited not rerun; reported only
per_cell_records: min bulk/tail ESS over reference parameters
refined-leaf fraction (retained built leaves above level 0)
max refinement level built and selected

side_checks.funnel: Neal's 10-D funnel at the sampler defaults with the arm's delta: 4 x 2,000 / 20,000, starts omega in {-3,-1,1,3}, threads 4. Records P(omega < -5) with ArviZ-style MCSE z (exact 0.0478) and batch-means z; the efficiency statistic = min over the ten coordinates (omega, x1..x9) of bulk ESS divided by all target calls (warmup included), geomean over the three seeds; per-chain final h, per-chain tail mass and omega mean, omega bulk/tail ESS and R-hat; divergences, exhaustions, depth caps; src/bin/funnel.rs
side_checks.eight_schools: eight_schools_v9_rebench_v1 strict track as in refinement_role_v1 (h 0.3, depth 8, eight levels, 4 x 1,000/1,000, threads 1, walnutpie facade, WarmupConfig::new(0.95) with mass adaptation, three bit-identical repetitions) with the arm's delta replacing 1; statistic min over the six v38 functionals of ArviZ bulk ESS / callbacks, geomean over seeds, ratio to d1. SECONDARY: reported, not part of the rule.

decision_rule.text: Flip the sampler default to the lowest-delta arm (d05 first, then d075) that meets ALL of: R1 geomean over the 17 models of the per-model ratio (seed-median min bulk ESS per gradient, arm / d1) >= 0.95; R2 no model's ratio < 0.85; R3 cells passing all gates >= d1's; R4 funnel |z| <= 2 on every seed; R5 funnel efficiency statistic (geomean over seeds of min bulk ESS / gradient over omega and x) >= 1.3x d1. A missing or errored cell makes R1/R2 unevaluable for that arm, which counts as not met. If no arm qualifies, delta = 1 stands. A qualifying arm is a recommendation: per the shared brief this branch does not change Tuning::default() (it would alter retained draws under the existing defaults); the flip is a separate labelled change for the coordinator.

predictions.P1_refinement: Refined-leaf fraction (median over models of seed medians) rises from ~0.002 at d1 to 0.003-0.008 at d075 and 0.006-0.03 at d05 (3-12x; the WP34 trace has P(|dH|>0.5) about 6x P(|dH|>1) at the adapted step). Median reverse-coarser stop fraction rises from ~0.03 to 0.04-0.08 (d075) and 0.06-0.15 (d05). Max refinement level built at d1 <= 3 on at least 14 of 17 models; at d05 it is at least one level higher on at least 8 models.
predictions.P2_step: Adapted h (geomean over models of the seed-median ratio to d1) within 0.90-1.02x for both arms: the coarse-endpoint statistic does not see delta directly, but more reverse-coarser warmup crashes (WP40) cut h slightly.
predictions.P3_cost: d05 geomean min-bulk-ESS/gradient vs d1 in 0.75-0.92 (fails R1); d075 in 0.88-0.98. Largest losses on the models with the heaviest |dH| tail and highest d1 reverse-coarser stops: accel_gp, gp_pois_regr, noncentered eight schools, diamonds; at least one of them < 0.85 at d05 (fails R2). Gradients overhead at d05: accel_gp 1.15-1.6x d1, gp_pois_regr 1.1-1.4x, median model 1.02-1.15x.
predictions.P4_gates: Gates at d05 and d075 within -4..+2 of d1 (d1 expected 42-45 of 51). Retained exhaustions stay zero on at least 14 of 17 models in every arm; depth-cap stops unchanged except diamonds.
predictions.P5_funnel: All three arms have |z| <= 2 on every seed (WP28: levels8 and levels8+delta0.5 both did). Funnel efficiency statistic: d05 1.5-4x d1 (WP28 omega ESS per call ~3x), d075 1.1-2.5x. At d1 at least two of the three seeds have a chain with final h < 0.02; at d05 at most one seed does.
predictions.P6_eight_schools: Eight Schools strict track d05 0.85-0.95x d1 (WP28: 0.91x), d075 0.92-1.0x.
predictions.P7_decision: No arm meets the rule: d05 passes R4 and R5 but fails R1 and/or R2; d075 fails R1, R2 or R5. delta = 1 stands; delta 0.5 remains the recommended opt-in for funnel-like targets.

reporting: All cells reported; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results. A driver crash is relaunched and the interrupted cell re-run from scratch (seeded) and recorded as a deviation. Wall-clock figures are contended (ten agents on 16 cores) and labelled as such; gradients, ESS, R-hat and z are the evidence.
